name: nearhub-repo
description: NearHub feature-based web and backend workspace

scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --prefix server && npm run test --prefix web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --prefix server && npm run test:coverage --prefix web
scripts.test:all: npm run test:coverage && npm run e2e
scripts.quality:server: npm run type-check --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix server
scripts.quality:web: npm run type-check --prefix web && npm run lint --prefix web
